assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. A SINGLE clean editorial illustration for hotel management software, landscape 1536x1024. Art direction: Day of the Tentacle 1993 cartoon adventure game, with unmistakably wonky angled perspective, skewed trapezoid props, expressive playful silhouettes, hand-inked dark contours, simple flat cel-painted planes. Simplify the scene radically: ONE clearly readable action or concept, at most 3 principal objects, large graphic shapes, 35% breathing room, no decorative clutter, no miniature details, no busy full-room backgrounds. Colors match a bright app palette: cyan #2ABDFF, pink #FF37C7, mint #00C3A0, violet #8251FB plus WHITE and their light tints. These are colorful objects, NOT grayscale objects! Soft very pale colored background, bright cheerful daylight. Do not use brown wood, gold, ochre, beige, red, orange, dark purple walls, dark scenes, or large black areas. No 3D rendering, no generic rounded corporate vector art. No text, logos, watermark, legible letters or numbers. This must read instantly at small size and communicate the hotel operation. Single wide hero background. A simple eccentric boutique hotel occupying the RIGHT 40%, three crooked floors, asymmetric violet roof and a pink entrance, white walls with cyan windows. ONE tiny lanky cartoon staff member at the entrance hands a key to ONE guest with mint suitcase. One small curved mint shrub at lower right. Left 60% and upper area quiet very pale pink sky with two simple white cloud strokes, intentionally clear for black headline overlay. Simple pale cyan path along bottom. No other buildings, no distant town, no trees filling frame, no pool, no mountain vista. DOTT oddball architecture but minimal, graphic, welcoming. Hotel is principal object.
